scope: Reconcile current open-source DWG/DXF libraries, CAD consumers, and ACIS/kernel tools by route, lineage, and evidence tier; refine existing plan gates without promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary project documentation, release notes, issue/PR status, and current format-route documentation
method.statusCaveat: Repository branches and issue pages are mutable. Peer issue reports are leads, not independently reproduced facts; open PR work is not released capability.

routes.name: LibreDWG
routes.evidence: Independent DWG/DXF implementation with version- and feature-specific reader/writer limits. Issue #1411 reports R2013+ AcDs/SAB carrier loss on a reporter-pinned 0.14.8593 route; not reproduced in this review.
routes.admission: Optional composed-checkpoint structural/differential peer; pin exact commit/build and actual output magic/version.

routes.name: ACadSharp
routes.evidence: Distinct structured reader/writer with a published version matrix. The 3DSOLID/REGION DXF omission report names v3.4.9; proposed DXF ACIS writer PR #1240 depends on the unmerged ACDS refactor #1174 and is not released capability.
routes.admission: Optional structured-document peer for exact supported cells; ACIS writing stays unqualified until the dependency chain is released/pinned and route-level owner/payload closure passes.
doesNotProve: a successful DWG read implies DXF write support

routes.name: ACadRust and OpenCADStudio
routes.evidence: OpenCADStudio identifies ACadRust as its native DWG/DXF engine and has a separate geometry/display path. These are not independent file-parser lineages; public claims do not provide a hash-pinned complete semantic report.
routes.admission: Count one codec lineage. A pinned distinct kernel/display stage may be reported separately and only for the behavior actually measured.
doesNotProve: B-rep validity from tessellation or successful open

routes.name: ezdxf ACIS route
routes.evidence: DXF-level SAT/SAB tooling and bounded control authoring, not a DWG/AcDs reader or geometry kernel. API/FAQ claims differ; unsupported ACIS entities can be lost and flat-face projection omits curved faces.
routes.admission: Exact-pinned local control author/parser at the composed checkpoint, with actual artifact route inspected.

routes.name: GDAL DXF/OGR
routes.evidence: Optional AC1027+ mode exposes raw ASM data and a 12-value transform but does not create OGR solid geometry; default mode skips modeler entities. Options can inline/merge blocks and writer output is AC2004. The DWG CAD driver is read-only geometry projection.
routes.admission: Optional carrier or explicit-geometry projection only; pin options and disable block inlining/merging for graph checks.

routes.name: OCCT and OCCT-based routes
routes.evidence: Current official documentation places ACIS SAT and DXF exchange in commercial Advanced Data Exchange Components, separate from the open-source OCCT core. FreeCAD, cq-acis, and CAD Assistant use OCCT geometry lineage; distinct frontends do not constitute independent kernels.
routes.admission: No FOSS ACIS/DXF route credit. If an already-authorized component is available, treat it as an optional shared-kernel measurement route and identify component/build/license explicitly.
doesNotProve: a licensed component is available or authorized

evidenceTiersToKeepSeparate: analytic B-rep validity and native application acceptance
implementationReadiness: Continue local work without waiting for another peer-discovery cycle.
Use affected strict build targets and focused fast tests per slice; keep peer/native runs at existing composed checkpoints.
Generate new controls from scratch in temporary storage; do not add downloaded peer drawings or new fixture files.
Record exact artifact/version, lineage, format versions, options, source handles, owner/block/INSERT path, carrier hashes, diagnostics/fallbacks, and result tier.
Mark unavailable peer cells NOT_RUN and continue implementation.
